look_here_first: Look for upper stem leaves that clasp LESS or taper rather than wrapping broadly. Check the mature capsule: the seed-release pore is often near the TIP rather than the middle as in typical clasping perfoliata. A violet flower by itself cannot distinguish the subspecies.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Small spring annual, often with open flowers above and inconspicuous closed flowers below.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Simple alternate leaves; often less conspicuously heart-shaped or clasping than in typical T. perfoliata.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Individual five-lobed purple open flowers and small closed self-pollinating flowers (cleistogamous) in leaf axils.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Inferior capsule with side openings often near apex; needs calibrated ripe side photo before confirming.
